Package org.bsc.langgraph4j

Class CompiledGraph<State extends AgentState>

java.lang.Object
org.bsc.langgraph4j.CompiledGraph<State>
Type Parameters:
State - the type of the state associated with the graph
All Implemented Interfaces:
GraphDefinition<State>, LG4JLoggable
public final class CompiledGraph<State extends AgentState> extends Object implements GraphDefinition<State>, LG4JLoggable
Represents a compiled graph of nodes and edges. This class manage the StateGraph execution

    • getStateHistory

      public Collection<StateSnapshot<State>> getStateHistory(RunnableConfig config)
      Gets the history of graph states relate to a specific Thread ID. Useful for: - Debugging execution history - Implementing time travel - Analyzing graph behavior
      Parameters:
      config - the RunnableConfig containing the thread ID information
      Returns:
      collection of StateSnapshots of the given Thread ID. The first element of collection is the last state

    • updateState

      public RunnableConfig updateState(RunnableConfig config, Map<String,Object> values, String asNode) throws Exception
      Update the state of the graph with the given values. If asNode is given, it will be used to determine the next node to run. If not given, the next node will be determined by the state graph.
      Parameters:
      config - the RunnableConfig containg the graph state
      values - the values to be updated
      asNode - the node id to be used for the next node. can be null
      Returns:
      the updated RunnableConfig
      Throws:
      Exception - when something goes wrong

    • invokeFinal

      public Optional<NodeOutput<State>> invokeFinal(GraphInput input, RunnableConfig config)
      Invokes the graph execution with the provided inputs and returns the final NodeOutput.

      The NodeOutput contains the final state of the graph and the ID of the last node that was executed. This is useful for determining if the graph finished normally (the node ID will be GraphDefinition.END) or was interrupted.

      Parameters:
      input - the input data for the graph execution.
      config - the configuration for this specific invocation.
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the final NodeOutput if the graph execution produced any output, otherwise an empty Optional.
      Since:
      1.6.1

      public <Output> Output reduce(GraphDefinition.Reducer<State,Output> reducer)
      Applies a reducer function to process the nodes and edges of this graph.

      This method allows external processing of the graph structure by applying a custom reduction function that receives all nodes and edges.
